text: The heart finds its rest only in the remembrance of God.
Whoever knows his own soul has begun to know his Lord.
Love the creation for the sake of the Creator.
God is nearest to the broken-hearted.
Patience is a seed of mercy planted in the soil of pain.
Do not rush your prayer; what is delayed is not denied.
The most desperate hour is the closest to God's relief.
Gratitude is the unseen hand that multiplies the little we have.
Trust in God after you have rowed; then let Him steer.
A heart full of God is never alone, even in a crowd.
Empty your heart of the world, and it will fill with light.
He who seeks God must first turn toward his own heart.
Forgiveness is the medicine that heals the heart fastest.
Tears are the clean water that washes the rust from the soul.
The mercy of God is greater than all our sins.
Humility is the most beautiful garment greatness can wear.
What the ego calls comfort is often the soul's captivity.
Remember your Lord, so that you do not lose yourself.
The one who relies on God does not carry tomorrow's weight today.
To gladden a single heart is the quietest act of worship.
Contentment is a treasure that never runs dry.
The soul polished by remembrance reflects the light it was made for.
Death is the meeting of the created with its Creator.
Hardship is the bridge that draws the servant nearest to his Lord.
Look not at the gift, but at the Giver.
Pride is a veil that blinds the heart to truth.
The richest soul is the one that is content with little.
Every breath is a chance, before it is called back.
When the tongue is silent, the heart begins to speak.
To despair of God's mercy is the deepest fall on the road.
An hour of reflection can outweigh a lifetime of heedless deeds.
The eye that looks with love sees its Lord in everything.
The truth descends not on proud hearts, but on humble ones.
Whoever fears God, God is enough for him.
Loneliness is peace for the one who has found God, a prison for the one who forgot Him.
A small step on the path of truth carries great reward.
Sincerity is the fragrance of a deed kept hidden.
Guard the mirror of your heart from dust, and you will see clearly.
The grateful increase; the ungrateful run dry.
God is with those who are patient.
Surrender your worry to God; that is what trust means.
However long the night, the dawn is God's promise.
Keep knocking, and the door of mercy will open.
The world is a bridge; cross it, do not build upon it.
Wound no heart, for God is a guest within it.
A sincere 'O my Lord' is better than a thousand idle words.
The worth of a person is measured by the love they carry.
Whoever submits his heart to God stays calm within the storm.
Faith is to surrender, from the heart, to the unseen.
When the heart clings to God, no broken rope can frighten it.
The path of good is often the one heaviest on the ego.
Be in this world as a stranger or a traveler passing through.
A tongue that remembers God awakens the heart as well.
Pleased with God's decree, the soul finds its deepest peace.
Whoever leans on God is never made small before any door.
The heart hardened by the world forgets its Lord.
Repentance is a door that stays open before the one who returns.
Love is the light of faith within the heart.
Prayer is the believer's strongest weapon in his weakest hour.
The one who tames his ego becomes a servant of his Lord, not of the world.
The light of God enters through the cracks of a humbled heart.
In the stillness of night, the closest words with God are spoken.
Charity given in secret puts out sin as water puts out fire.
Knowledge without humility is a lamp that blinds instead of guiding.
Guard your tongue; a word can wound what years cannot heal.
Envy devours the one who carries it long before it reaches another.
Walk between fear and hope, and you will fall into neither despair nor pride.
Remember the grave, and the world shrinks to its true size.
The remembrance of God is rain upon the dry land of the heart.
Keep asking; the One you ask never tires of being asked.
Beneath the feet of mothers a hidden garden of mercy grows.
Modesty is a branch of faith that shades the whole soul.
The strongest is the one who restrains his anger while it burns.
Truthfulness gives the heart a peace that lies can never buy.
Lift your brother's burden, and your own chest grows lighter.
Be gentle with every creature; mercy is the signature of faith.
A sin left in shame is dearer to God than a deed done in pride.
Simplicity frees the heart that abundance had taken captive.
Purify the intention, and even small deeds grow great.
Each dawn is a clean page; do not stain it with yesterday's regret.
The greatest book to read is the Quran; the next, the human heart.
Prayer is a stream; bathe in it and the soul stays clean.
Lower yourself before God, and He will raise you before people.
Life is a single step taken toward God.
Hope in God is a light that no darkness can outlast.
Whoever remembers God often carries little sorrow.
A heart that forgives rests in a peace the resentful never taste.
What is meant for you will not pass you; what passes you was never yours.
Trust the timing of the One who never forgets a single seed.
Mercy shown today is mercy stored for the day you will need it most.
Let go of what your hands cannot hold, and your heart will rest.
The servant nearest to God is the one kindest to His servants.
Fear no door while your hope is fastened to the Lord of all doors.
Do not let the gift make you forget the One who gave it.
The heart that depends on God is calm even when the rope of this world snaps.
Worship done quietly weighs more than a mountain done for show.
A grateful glance turns an ordinary day into a gift.
The tear shed for God will not be shed in the life to come.
Soften your heart, and your words will become a cure.
Return to God before you are returned to Him.
